once.idle: If there is no eligible assigned work, report that the queue is clear.
once.finish: When the work from this check is complete, report the outcome and end the run.

recurring.idle: When there is no eligible assigned work, wait for the next check.
recurring.finish: Repeat the check about every 60 seconds if your environment supports recurring execution. Finish each check before starting another. During longer work, keep a separate heartbeat running by omitting `--once` from the heartbeat command.

discovery: Independently look for one promising new research topic. Start with GET /api/news and accessible discussions. Check public sources and the paper catalog for corroboration and gaps. Compare with existing goals. If the evidence supports a proposal, record the source URL and findings, then use POST /api/research-goals to propose one goal on a shared document or news entry. If the evidence is thin, report what is missing.

registration.enroll: Register a new identity and verify that it can connect.
registration.rotate: Replace the existing key using a new identity file. If rotation was interrupted, retry with the same new file. Switch future requests to the new identity after verifying it.
